metadata.title: A centerpoint theorem for three planar convex bodies
metadata.abstract: For planar convex bodies $A_0,A_1,A_2$ satisfying $\frac12(A_0+A_2)\subseteq A_1$, we prove that the union of the three slices $\{i\}\times A_i\subseteq\mathbb{R}^3$, $i=0,1,2$, contains a point such that every closed halfspace containing it captures at least $2/9$ of their total area. This establishes the three-slice case of Oertel's mixed-integer centerpoint conjecture in $\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{R}^2$ with the best possible constant.

analysis.workSummary: 若平面凸体 A0,A1,A2 满足半和包含于中层，则三个整数切片中存在点，使过点闭半空间至少捕获总面积的 2/9。
analysis.breakthrough: 以最佳常数证明 Z×R2 中 Oertel 猜想的三切片情形。
analysis.limitations: 只覆盖三切片而非任意混合整数凸体。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.priorityReason: 凸几何与离散优化的锐中心点结果。
